name: DCX Pipeline
aliases: Deep Marching Cubes Data Pipeline & Mesh Extraction
definition: A pipeline for converting point clouds to meshes using voxelization, cube type classification, thinning, and reconstruction, exposed via a Python binding module named DCX_main.
summary: The DCX Pipeline converts volumetric inputs into explicit triangle meshes by learning discrete topology and continuous vertex offsets, distinguishing itself through explicit topological control and supplementary hole filling.
